rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a natural cave in a mountain, hillside, or cliff.

example.english: We walked into the cave to shelter from the rain.
example.traditional: 我哋行到山洞入面避雨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haang4 dou3 saan1 dung6 jap6 min6 bei6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this for a hole or opening in earth or rock, especially when it is not a large walk-in cavern.

example.english: There’s a cave behind this rock, so be careful not to fall in.
example.traditional: 呢塊石後面有個窿，小心跌親。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 sek6 hau6 min6 jau5 go3 lung1 siu2 sam1 dit3 can1

rows.note: Use this for a general underground storage cellar, including one used for cheese.

example.english: We use this cave cellar to store cheese.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 gaau3 jung6 lai4 baai2 zi1 si2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a wine cellar rather than a general storage cellar.

example.english: We keep the wine in the cave wine cellar.
example.traditional: 我哋將啲酒放喺酒窖入面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 zau2 fong3 hai2 zau2 gaau3 jap6 min6
